homepage.description: Ada Computer Science is a free learning platform for computing teachers and students. Developed by the Raspberry Pi Foundation in partnership with the Isaac Science team at the University of Cambridge, it is tailored to support learners aged 14-19. Ada Computer Science offers structured resources to support both teachers and students. These include concept pages, interactive questions, and teacher tools, amongst a wide range of other resources designed to enhance computer science education.
